info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-Create Pharmacy Prescriptions Refill-v2-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescription Refill API enables authorized users to initiate the refill process for prescription medications efficiently. This API streamlines the management of prescription refills, allowing pharmacies to respond promptly to patient needs. Typical users include pharmacists, pharmacy staff, and healthcare providers seeking to enhance patient care and adherence to medication therapy. By utilizing this API, organizations can improve operational workflows and ensure timely access to necessary medications for patients.

post.summary: Request a refill for a prescription.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to request a refill for existing prescriptions. Ensure that the prescription is eligible for refilling and that all necessary details are provided in the request body.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to refill a prescription. It must include the necessary details related to the prescription, such as the prescription ID and patient information, to process the refill request successfully.

200.description: Refill request processed successfully, returning current prescription details.
